what: persona-bot orders compiled by the live compiler (internal QA, not users)

results.orders: Guarding alone got me nowhere. Open by guarding, then share with anyone who shared with me, and keep guarding otherwise.
readback: - From turn 11, first matching rule wins:
1. If my neighbour shared with me in the last 10 turns → SHARE (trade generously).

results.orders: I lost by gathering alone. Share with everyone from the start and keep sharing, but guard against anyone who steals from me.
readback: - From turn 11, first matching rule wins:
1. If my neighbour stole from me in the last 3 turns → GUARD (protect your coins).

results.orders: Stealing when behind did not work. Share by default, and only steal back from someone who stole from me.
readback: - From turn 11, first matching rule wins:
1. If my neighbour stole from me in the last 3 turns → STEAL (rob your neighbour).

results.orders: Share with poorer partners, and copy the leader only if I am behind. Otherwise share.
readback: - From turn 11, first matching rule wins:
1. If I am in the bottom half → COPY_LEADER (do what the top agent did last turn).
2. If my neighbour has fewer coins than me → SHARE (trade generously).
